# Pipeline toolchain — pinned deps for the org quality workflows (CI installs
# them with `pip install -r .github/requirements-ci.txt`; repos with a Makefile
# also get them via `make install`), watched by dependabot (pip ecosystem,
# directory: /.github). Lives at .github/requirements-ci.txt. Keep py3.8-compatible: the quality workflow
# runs these inside the noetic-base (focal) container.
# NB: keep the pins alphabetical — the requirements-txt-fixer hook enforces it.
catkin-lint==1.6.25
# rebuild.py's manifest parser (condition evaluation); 1.1.0 is the version
# validated in the noetic image against format-3 dual packages, py3.8-ok.
catkin-pkg==1.1.0
# Pinned binary wheel so the format verdict is host-independent
# (apt ships v10 on focal, v22+ elsewhere).
clang-format==22.1.8
cmakelint==1.4.3
# Transitive dep of catkin-lint, pinned here because it is the py3.8 floor:
# lxml 6.1.3 (2026-09-02) ships no cp38 wheels, so pip falls back to the
# sdist and the noetic-base (focal) container has no libxml2/libxslt headers.
lxml==6.1.2
mypy==1.14.1
pre-commit==3.5.0        # last py3.8 line
pyright==1.1.414         # node launcher wheel (py3.8-ok); fetches node via nodeenv
ruff==0.16.5
types-PyYAML==6.0.12.20241230
vcstool==0.3.0
